comment: Signatures and constants for subpixel text, in the format of xivres's data/game_font_signatures.json (see its comment); merged after it by CodeSignature, and by XivAlexander's GameLayout. Addresses are of 7.56h.

AtkServer.TextPass.description: The pass of plain text among the 9 font shader pairs (FontVS/FontPS).

AtkServer.HighlightPass.description: The pass of highlighted text (FontHighlightVS/FontHighlightPS: the text colour inverted).

AtkServer.EmbossPass.description: The pass of the drop shadow (FontEmbossVS/FontEmbossPS, which is FontPS's bytecode).

AtkServer.TextPixelShaderFile.description: The file name of the text pass's pixel shader.

AtkServer.HighlightPixelShaderFile.description: The file name of the highlight pass's pixel shader.

AtkServer.EmbossPixelShaderFile.description: The file name of the shadow pass's pixel shader.

AtkServerSetDrawState.description: void AtkServer.SetDrawState(AtkServer* this, DrawState* state, byte textureDivisor) (FUN_14063BA60 in 7.56h): before a batch of UI draw commands, stages the packed blend state (state+0, masked with 0x7FFFFFF), the texture (state+8; the white or black one if null) and g_TextureParam = the texture's size / textureDivisor. ProcessUICommands calls it only when the blend, texture or a few other fields change, not when only the pass does. Resolves to the function containing the match.

captures.name: Kernel.Texture.Width
captures.description: uint (0x38), divided for g_TextureParam; the height follows.

AtkServerBeginRenderTexture.description: AtkServer.SetRenderTexture(AtkServer* this, bool begin, Kernel::Texture* target, Matrix* transform, bool clear) (FUN_14063B790 in 7.56h), for a type 1 UI command: begin sets a flag, switches the render target to the texture and the projection to the transform; the end clears the flag. Nameplate bakes are drawn this way.

captures.name: AtkServer.RenderingToTexture
captures.description: byte: drawing into a texture, not the back buffer (0x8670).

AtkServerEndRenderTexture.description: The end of AtkServer.SetRenderTexture (FUN_14063B790 in 7.56h), clearing the flag before restoring the projection.
